description: Estimate a Washington home seller's net proceeds: commission, graduated REET, title/escrow/closing costs, mortgage payoff, and optional HOA/tax prorations — every line item computed deterministically by the same engine SENTINEL's product uses. Use for 'what will the seller walk away with' questions on WA sales; WA counties only. The result is an itemized dict. Uses no third-party data. The result includes an 'attributions' array (upstream source lines and the NWMLS/DOR/county non-affiliation line) and a professional-advice disclaimer — pass both through to end users.

commissionRate.description: Total commission as a decimal fraction (0.05 = 5%). Defaults to the NWMLS-typical rate.
